name: School Five ~Itsutsu no Himitsu no Monogatari~
original_name: すく～るふぁいぶ～五つの秘密の物語～
source:
This game contains strange love stories of five couples. You can enjoy various stories of mysterious heroines at school in the country. Five stories are connected to each other and it affects your ending. The story grows deeper as it goes and becomes one grand story.... 

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090227112940/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/54/products_id/1012014]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
本作包含5对情侣的奇异爱情故事。玩家可以体验发生在乡间学校、围绕神秘女主角展开的各种剧情。5个故事彼此相连，并会影响最终结局。随着进展，剧情将不断深入，最终汇成一部宏大的故事……

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090227112940/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/54/products_id/1012014]ErogeShop[/url]]
